# Startup readback: AI-17

Contract version: 1

## Objective and acceptance outcomes

Implement durable inter-agent requests and explicit ownership transfers on the canonical runtime so Planner and specialists can request bounded work, return evidence to the initiating owner, and resume without hidden model recursion or lost context.

1. A request has a typed destination/objective/output contract, bounded context/evidence references, source run/message, owner, status, deterministic idempotency key, deadline and result reference; invalid routing/capability requests fail clearly.
2. Ownership transfer is a durable, audited event separate from an information request. Specialist results return to the original run/conversation with correlation and evidence, while direct user-to-specialist conversations remain valid.
3. Depth/duplicate-cycle limits, timeout/failure escalation and dependency waits are deterministic and recoverable: no unbounded nested calls, duplicate completed work, or orphaned silent requests.

## Implementation and boundaries

After the readback and integration review, trace the current AI-14 request/handoff contracts, AI-15 run and manager-core lifecycle, AI-16 capability/tool policy, and their direct callers/consumers. Reuse existing request/handoff entities, services, RPCs and fixture paths. Implement only missing request state transitions, deterministic routing and safe queue/orchestrator resumption; persist ownership history and surface timeouts/failures through the existing attention/trace path. Keep cost/correlation ownership with the existing AI-20/AI-19 paths. Any shared cost or acceptance interface change must be coordinated with the parent before editing.

Do not add a second conversation/request store, prompt-only delegation, synchronous recursive model-to-model loops, broad service-role table access, new AI policy/budget logic, or manager-specific business reasoning. Do not make Planner a mandatory hop for a direct specialist conversation. No subagents are planned; one owner remains accountable through release.

## Remaining-work readback after interface inspection

- AI-14 already defines the typed `InterAgentRequest`/`InterAgentReply` contracts, transition helper, service-only tables, and allowed lifecycle states. Repository search found no production caller or service path for those entities; their use is currently limited to the migration, generated DB types, and contracts.
- AI-15's `ai-execute` loads one trusted run and its queue input, then creates a single report; the webhook validates and commits that report. Neither path creates a specialist run, links a reply to the source run, or resumes the source after a reply.
- The current AI-14 request row has no destination-run or ancestry link. Durable runtime work therefore needs a transactional, idempotent linkage using the existing request/reply/run tables; do not add another request store.
- The manager-core policy rejects self-routes, repeated managers, source/path owner mismatch, and delegation deeper than four edges. Direct specialist origins remain valid. Producer/consumer tests now cover canonical AI-14 requests, owner-checked replies, root-run inheritance on nested specialist runs, and source-lineage mismatch rejection; the focused seven-test package run and typecheck pass.
- The persistence seam passes the resolved cost root to the atomic request/run/queue operation. A concrete database implementation must revalidate the source-run lineage and set `workflow_runs.cost_root_run_id` from `coalesce(source.cost_root_run_id, source.id)` in the same transaction; the specialist call and reservation rows remain attributed to the child run.
- Shared Supabase use is held by AI-28. No migration, Edge persistence implementation, or hosted work has started. Parent reserved `20261021155523` for this ticket after a current sibling PR migration inventory; use only after the shared lease is released and rechecking heads.

Integration contract: use the canonical AI-14 request/handoff and AI-15 run/queue paths with their existing least-privilege service/RPC boundary; apply DB-03/DB-05 for migrations or persisted SQL, DB-02 for protected trace diagnostics, EDGE-01/EDGE-02 for Edge imports/workspace test staging, AI-01 if model output schemas change, OPS-01 for actionable redacted failures, and ACC-01/ACC-02 for hosted evidence or a real MFA checkpoint. COST-01 requires child runs to inherit the original on-demand root while preserving child-level call attribution. Re-check against actual changed paths before edits; add a failure-ledger row only for a confirmed novel integration defect.

## Local tests and commands

- Focused state-machine/contract tests for allowed and denied routing, each valid transition, ownership history, bounded depth/cycle detection, duplicate idempotency, deadlines, retryable vs terminal errors, and output-contract validation.
- Focused orchestrator/DB proof using real caller roles: concurrent request creation/claim, wait/resume of the originating run, exactly-once completion/evidence linkage, failure→attention escalation, and trace/cost correlation. Keep deterministic cycle/timeout matrices local; do not add recursive live calls.
- Use the narrow failing transition as the debug loop; run `corepack pnpm verify:changed` before PR/hosted acceptance. `corepack pnpm qa:doctor --fix` passed in this refreshed checkout.

## Hosted proof and readiness

AI-17 explicitly requires one real staging Planner→specialist journey that persists the request, specialist run, reply and consolidated result. Include one real durable ownership handoff if the changed service path persists that transition. Keep deliberate circular delegation, duplicate request and failure/timeout matrices local. Use the exact immutable candidate, staging lease and current acceptance-evidence producer→validator→consumer contract; verify applicable DB grants/fixtures before dispatch. If a headed app login/MFA prompt appears, tell the operator when the browser is ready and pause for their action. Bound any provider use to the existing approved workflow budget/model policy and record no secret or raw personal payload.
